def dots(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['pixels']==12 and n['color'] in ('N','g'):
            b=n['boundary']; out.append((n['color'], min(p[0] for p in b), min(p[1] for p in b)))
    return sorted(out)
def lock(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='O':
            b=n['boundary']; return (min(p[0] for p in b), min(p[1] for p in b))
